description: Image Description: The image shows a row of surfboards standing upright, closely lined up next to each other. The surfboards vary in color, including shades of yellow, white, orange, and blue. Each board has a fin visible at the bottom, and some have leashes attached. The lighting suggests a sunny outdoor setting, casting shadows on the boards, highlighting their smooth, glossy surfaces and the curvature of their designs. The arrangement suggests they might be in a rental or storage area near a beach
